mainEntity.name: What content should a remodeling website include for better optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remodeling website optimized for search engines and user engagement should include high-quality, relevant content. This includes detailed service pages for various remodeling types (kitchens, bathrooms, additions), project galleries with high-resolution images and descriptions, client testimonials or case studies, and informative blog posts about remodeling trends, tips, and common challenges. An 'About Us' page detailing your experience and unique selling points, and a clear 'Contact Us' page with location details, are also essential. Content should address common customer questions and showcase your expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Optimized remodeling websites need detailed service pages, project galleries, testimonials, informative blog posts, and clear contact information. Content should showcase expertise and answer client questions.
